# Gramlot examples 0.2.11

## Changes

- Three controllers pages use the declarative server round trips of the core 0.2.16, in Python and JavaScript: `c12` Remote (`12_remote`, `remote` on a section whose content is the fragment of a `@source` / `Page.registerSource` method, requested again when its `^` parameter changes), `c13` Cached remote (`13_cached_remote`, `_cachedRemote` makes no request for an equal parameter under a variable datapath, `_onRemote` writes the status), `c14` Data remote (`14_data_remote`, `dataRemote` with `cacheTime=5` read by a `^.menu` consumer and loaded again when its `^` argument changes). The controllers family is now `c01`–`c14`, and the gallery has 39 routes.
- The jsdom tests, the Python page tests and the browser check exercise the fragments of c12 and c13 and the endpoint of c14.

## Requirements

Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.16 or later; Node.js 22 or later, or Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.16 or later.
